summary: node-telegram-sockets 1.1.6: static keyword matches without traced-code corroboration
details: node-telegram-sockets is a Telegram Bot API client library. Static keyword matches fired on co-occurrence of 'ping' tokens in lib/telegram.js, src/telegram.js, and test/telegram.js (consistent with the library's pingMessage/answerInlineQuery/ping-related Telegram API surface, not OS ping reconnaissance), and on co-occurrence of fs.readFileSync + http/https requires in telegramWebHook.js (consistent with reading a TLS certificate and key from disk to start an HTTPS webhook server, which is the documented Telegram webhook pattern). No hardcoded non-Telegram destination, no credential or home-directory scan, no install-time lifecycle script, and no obfuscation were identified in the evidence. The keyword shapes alone do not establish installer-side harm, but full behavioral tracing did not complete, so the disposition is human review rather than allow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
